import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(r"\b(TMP|[abcd])\s*<-\s*(TMP|[abcd]|-?\d+)\b")

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; c ?= {values['c']}; "
    f"d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
